objective: Provide one atomic master workbook import for Distributor Status, Renewal, Receivables, and historical confirmed Payments while preserving canonical domain authorities.

humanGate.reason: Owner must manually apply reviewed Migration 046; Codex remains read-only against production Supabase.

budgets.dataAuthority: Distributor operational and renewal facts remain in distributor_accounts; obligations remain in receivables; payment events remain in receivable_payments; collection state remains derived.
budgets.readBudget: Preview resolves distributor references, employee emails, receivable keys, and payment import keys in bounded set/chunk reads with no per-row network queries.
budgets.writeBudget: Confirmation may write only distributor_accounts and its existing event/receipt authorities, receivables and their existing event/receipt authorities, receivable_payments, and distributor_master_import_batches in one transaction.
budgets.rlsModel: Master orchestration metadata and function are service-role only; browser writes are revoked.
budgets.indexRequirements: Unique partial normalized payment import key per receivable; existing Migration 045 distributor/receivable keys reused.
budgets.failureMode: Any blocking row, stale resolved plan, authority rejection, or unexpected error yields zero partial business writes.
budgets.concurrencyModel: Database uniqueness, row locks, existing expected-version semantics, and one outer PostgreSQL transaction protect concurrent confirmation.
budgets.idempotencyModel: Stable operation/request/payload hashes plus distributor reference, receivable bill key, and per-receivable payment import key make replay deterministic.
budgets.testPlan: Focused parser/planner/API/UI tests, disposable PostgreSQL apply/invariant/idempotency/concurrency/rollback proof, compatibility regressions, focused E2E, typecheck, scoped lint, build, and Graph proof.

acceptance.description: Use exact filename ZeroData_Distributor_Master_Import.xlsx; exact Distributors, Receivables, Payments, Instructions sheets and requested columns; reject unknown/duplicate headers and formulas; allow at least one business row; bound XLSX to 10 MB and 5,000 total rows; document realistic examples and formula safety.

Distributor rows resolve case-insensitive Distributor Reference only, never fuzzy names; existing blanks mean NO_CHANGE, [CLEAR] only clears legal nullable fields, and new rows require complete valid operational state; reuse exact active non-Admin employee resolver and preserve phone, city, notes, renewal and lifecycle authority.

Receivables use exactly the requested eight columns, derive assignment from the post-import Distributor, allow same-workbook billed onboarding, skip exact distributor_id+bill_reference duplicates, block conflicting obligations, and require a valid follow-up only when the complete planned payment result remains outstanding.

Payments create separate confirmed receivable_payments events using nullable import_key and a unique normalized per-receivable partial index; exact replay skips, material conflict blocks, concurrent replay cannot duplicate money, and PAID/PARTIALLY_PAID remain derived only.

Preview performs zero writes, uses the exact requested classifications, resolves complete cross-sheet before/action/after state including all planned payments, hashes canonical resolved IDs/actions, and confirmation rebuilds from the same raw workbook with 409 IMPORT_REFRESH_REQUIRED on change.
Confirmation is atomic across Distributor, Renewal, Receivable and Payment writes; any validation or conflict failure produces zero partial business writes.

Admin Distributor Collections prominently offers Import / Update Master Workbook, exact template download, XLSX-only upload, requested summary/table/action labels, blocking-row disablement, atomicity warning, completion counts, and refresh while preserving both legacy importers.
Existing Distributor Import, Receivables Import, manual Receivable creation, manual Record Payment, employee payment reporting, renewal flows, and PR61 numeric-wire contract remain compatible.
Focused database, unit, E2E, typecheck, lint, and build verification proves complete end-to-end workbook behavior against production-shaped disposable fixtures.
Owner manually applies reviewed Migration 046; production is then certified read-only before release completion.
